lastCompletedStory.title: Autostart the hub from the thin proxies by execPath, and clear the residual name literals

nextStoryContext: The six thin-proxy `doBootstrap` fallbacks (plan/next/issue/spec/review/ship, previously byte-identical `spawnSync('cam', ['run', '--no-attach'])`) now all delegate to a single new shared module `src/util/hub-bootstrap.ts`: `buildHubAutostartArgv(execPath, argv1)` is a thin wrapper over US-002's `buildSelfSpawnArgv` fixed to the `run --no-attach` subcommand, and `bootstrapHub(cwd)` is the shared fallback that resolves argv from `process.execPath`/`process.argv[1]`, spawns it synchronously via node:child_process's spawnSync (dynamic import, matching the pre-existing per-command style), and reports success via `(result.status ?? 1) === 0` exactly as before. Each command's `doBootstrap` is now just `if (bootstrapFn) return bootstrapFn(); return bootstrapHub(cwd);` -- the injectable `bootstrapFn` seam, cwd, and stdio:'ignore' semantics are all unchanged, so the six proxies' existing tests kept passing unmodified. The remaining literal-name comment in `src/commands/sidecar.ts` (documenting why `cam sidecar` is a real registered subcommand) was reworded to reference `buildSidecarSpawnArgv(execPath, argv1)` (the US-002 builder that actually spawns it) instead of the literal `Bun.spawn(['cam', 'sidecar', ...])` string. GOTCHA hit and resolved: destructuring the shared argv array (`const [cmd, ...args] = argv`) does NOT satisfy `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` the way you'd expect from a plain array type -- TS still infers `cmd: string | undefined` from a `string[]`-typed source in this codebase's tsconfig, so `bootstrapHub` instead reads `argv[0]` into a local, does a `cmd === undefined` early-return guard (an intentionally-unreachable branch since the builder always returns >= 3 elements), and passes `argv.slice(1)` as the args array; this is the pattern to copy for any future shared-argv-builder consumer. Quality spine required one file-size ceiling raise: `src/commands/sidecar.ts` 3721->3722 (the reworded comment is 1 line longer than the original); `scripts/file-size-budget.json`'s `_ref` was updated and staged per protocol, no other budget touched. AC7/AC8 packaging/contract-count invariance pins were both re-verified live post-change (package.json name unchanged, no install.sh, CAM_/.cam-/tmux -L cam/`/cam-` occurrence counts in src+index.ts identical to main) and pass cleanly since this story never touched packaging or the five ADR-0054 internal-contract literal families.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed spawnSync's returned `status` is a number on normal exit and `null` only when the child was terminated by a signal, and that spawnSync (unlike execSync/execFileSync) never throws on a non-zero exit code. The `(result.status ?? 1) === 0` guard carried into the new shared bootstrapHub helper matches this exactly (pre-existing behavior, unchanged by this story).
